title: Telefon, internet va ijtimoiy tarmoqlar
goal_uz: Dars oxirida telefon va internet so‘zlarini ishlatasiz, onlayn odatlaringizni takrorlanish so‘zlari bilan tasvirlaysiz, afzallik va kamchiliklarni ayta olasiz hamda telefonda va yozishmada asosiy iboralarni qo‘llaysiz.

scenes.title: Telefon, internet va ijtimoiy tarmoqlar
board: Lesson 22: Phones, Internet and Social Media
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Yigirma ikkinchi darsga xush kelibsiz. O‘tgan darsda pul, narx va savdolashish haqida gaplashdik. Bugun har kuni qo‘limizdagi narsa haqida: telefon, internet va ijtimoiy tarmoqlar. Siz texnika so‘zlarini o‘rganasiz, onlayn odatlaringizni tasvirlaysiz, afzallik va kamchiliklarni aytasiz va raqamli muloqot iboralarini ishlatasiz.
scenes.say: Hello again! Today we talk about phones, the internet and social media. You will describe how you use your phone every day.
scenes.say_uz: Yana salom! Bugun telefon, internet va ijtimoiy tarmoqlar haqida gaplashamiz. Telefondan har kuni qanday foydalanishingizni tasvirlaysiz.

scenes.title: Telefon qismlari
board: a smartphone · a screen · a battery

examples.t: My phone has a big screen.

scenes.say_native: Boshlaymiz telefon so‘zlaridan. “Smartphone” — aqlli telefon, “screen” — ekran, “battery” — batareya, “charger” — zaryadlovchi, “headphones” — quloqchin. “Case” — telefon g‘ilofi. Ilova — “app”, bu “application” so‘zining qisqartmasi. Xabar — “message”. Esda tuting: “headphones” har doim ko‘plikda, chunki ikkita quloq bor. Shuning uchun “my headphones are new” deymiz, “is” emas.
scenes.say: A smartphone has a screen and a battery. I need a charger. My headphones are new. This app is free.
scenes.say_uz: Smartfonning ekrani va batareyasi bor. Menga zaryadlovchi kerak. Quloqchinlarim yangi. Bu ilova bepul.

scenes.title: Internet so‘zlari
board: a password · an account · a link
scenes.say_native: Internet so‘zlari. “Wi-Fi” — simsiz tarmoq, “website” — veb-sayt, “password” — parol, “account” — akkaunt, “link” — havola. “Download” — yuklab olish, “upload” — yuklash. “Online” — tarmoqda, “offline” — tarmoqdan tashqarida. Kafeda eng ko‘p beriladigan savol: “What’s the Wi-Fi password?” Esda tuting: “the internet” da odatda “the” ishlatamiz, “Wi-Fi” da esa artikl kerak emas.
scenes.say: What's the Wi-Fi password? I download apps. I upload photos. I'm online all day.
scenes.say_uz: Wi-Fi paroli qanday? Men ilovalarni yuklab olaman. Men suratlarni yuklayman. Men kun bo‘yi onlaynman.

scenes.title: Takrorlang
scenes.say_native: Takrorlang. “Smartphone” da urg‘u birinchi bo‘g‘inda: SMART-fone. “Battery” — BA-te-ri, o‘rtadagi unli deyarli aytilmaydi. “Password” — PASS-werd, urg‘u birinchi bo‘g‘inda. “Account” — a-COUNT, urg‘u ikkinchida. Har bir so‘zni ikki marta ayting.
scenes.say: Smartphone. Screen. Battery. Charger. Password. Account.
scenes.say_uz: Smartfon. Ekran. Batareya. Zaryadlovchi. Parol. Akkaunt.

scenes.title: Ijtimoiy tarmoq so‘zlari
board: social media · a post · a photo
a follower · a like · a comment
to share · to follow · to scroll

examples.t: She has a lot of followers.

scenes.say_native: Ijtimoiy tarmoqlar ingliz tilida “social media”. Odatda bu so‘z birlikdek ishlatiladi: “social media is popular”. “Post” — e’lon yoki joylama, “follower” — obunachi, “like” — yoqtirish, “comment” — izoh. Fe’llar: “share” — ulashish, “follow” — kuzatish, “scroll” — lentani aylantirish. “Scroll” — SKROL, “c” harfi “k” deb o‘qiladi, “o” cho‘ziq. Bu so‘zlar sizga tanish, shuning uchun osongina yodlaysiz.
scenes.say: Social media is popular. I follow my friends. I share photos. She scrolls all evening.
scenes.say_uz: Ijtimoiy tarmoqlar mashhur. Men do‘stlarimni kuzataman. Men suratlarni ulashaman. U kechqurun bo‘yi lentani aylantiradi.

scenes.title: Ilova va qurilma
scenes.say_native: Ikki xato. Birinchisi: ijtimoiy tarmoq va ilova nomlari oldidan artikl qo‘yish. Ingliz tilida “Instagram”, “YouTube”, “Telegram” oldidan “the” aytilmaydi: “I opened Instagram”. Ikkinchisi: “in the internet”. Internetda bo‘lish uchun “on the internet” yoki shunchaki “online” deymiz. Predlog “on” ishlatiladi, chunki internet tarmoq sifatida qaraladi. “I found it on the internet” — men buni internetdan topdim.
scenes.say: I opened Instagram. I found it on the internet. I'm online now.
scenes.say_uz: Men Instagramni ochdim. Men buni internetdan topdim. Men hozir onlaynman.

scenes.title: Tuzating
board: 2) She found it in the internet.
scenes.say_native: Uchta gapda xato bor. Birinchi gap: men Telegramdan foydalanaman. Ikkinchi gap: u buni internetdan topdi. Uchinchi gap: mening quloqchinlarim yangi. Har birini baland ovozda to‘g‘rilab ayting. Avvalgi ikki qoida va ko‘plik haqida eslang.
scenes.say: One: I use the Telegram. Two: She found it in the internet. Three: My headphones is new. Correct each sentence.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: I use the Telegram. Ikki: She found it in the internet. Uch: My headphones is new. Har bir gapni to‘g‘rilang.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 2) She found it on the internet.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “I use Telegram”, artikl yo‘q. Ikkinchi: “She found it on the internet”, predlog “on”. Uchinchi: “My headphones are new”, chunki “headphones” ko‘plik. Uchala xato ham o‘zbekchadan o‘tadi, shuning uchun ularni sezish uchun vaqt kerak. Agar hammasini topgan bo‘lsangiz, ajoyib, topmagan bo‘lsangiz ham muammo yo‘q, keyingi mashqlarda yana uchraydi.
scenes.say: I use Telegram. She found it on the internet. My headphones are new.
scenes.say_uz: Men Telegramdan foydalanaman. U buni internetdan topdi. Quloqchinlarim yangi.

scenes.title: Telefon bilan nima qilamiz
board: make a call · answer the phone
charge your phone · turn it on / off

examples.t: I charge my phone at night.

scenes.say_native: Telefon bilan bog‘liq fe’llar. “Make a call” — qo‘ng‘iroq qilish, “answer the phone” — telefonga javob berish. “Send a message” — xabar yuborish, “receive” — olish. “Charge” — zaryadlash. “Turn on” va “turn off” — yoqish va o‘chirish. Bular frazal fe’llar: ikki so‘zdan iborat, ma’nosi alohida. Olmosh bilan ular ajraladi: “turn it off”, “turn off it” emas.
scenes.say: I make a call. I answer the phone. I send messages. Please turn it off.
scenes.say_uz: Men qo‘ng‘iroq qilaman. Men telefonga javob beraman. Men xabar yuboraman. Iltimos, uni o‘chiring.

scenes.title: Frazal fe’l va olmosh
scenes.say_native: Muhim qoida. Frazal fe’lning to‘ldiruvchisi olmosh bo‘lsa, olmosh fe’l bilan zarracha orasiga tushadi: “turn it off”, “switch it on”, “pick it up”. “Turn off it” noto‘g‘ri. Agar to‘ldiruvchi oddiy ot bo‘lsa, ikkala tartib to‘g‘ri: “turn off the phone” va “turn the phone off”. O‘zbek tilida bunday qoida yo‘q, shuning uchun uni yodlab olish kerak. Bir nechta misol ayting.
scenes.say: Turn it off. Switch it on. Turn off the phone. Turn the phone off.
scenes.say_uz: Uni o‘chiring. Uni yoqing. Telefonni o‘chiring. Telefonni o‘chiring.

scenes.title: Olmosh bilan ayting
scenes.say_native: Har bir gapda ot o‘rniga olmosh qo‘ying. Birinchi: telefonni o‘chiring. Ikkinchi: televizorni yoqing. Uchinchi: musiqani pastroq qiling. Namuna: “turn the phone off” bo‘ladi “turn it off”. Olmosh “it” bo‘ladi. Uchala gapni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Turn the phone off. Switch the TV on. Turn the music down. Now use it in each sentence.
scenes.say_uz: Telefonni o‘chiring. Televizorni yoqing. Musiqani pastroq qiling. Endi har gapda it ishlating.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. “Turn it off”, “switch it on”, “turn it down”. Hammasida “it” fe’l bilan zarracha orasida turibdi. Qo‘shimcha ma’lumot: “turn up” — balandroq qilish, “turn down” — pastroq qilish. Ovoz uchun ham, haroratga ham ishlatiladi. Shuning uchun bu frazal fe’llar kundalik hayotda juda ko‘p uchraydi.
scenes.say: Turn it off. Switch it on. Turn it down.
scenes.say_uz: Uni o‘chiring. Uni yoqing. Uni pastroq qiling.

scenes.title: Onlayn odatlar: takrorlanish
board: every day · twice a day · all the time

examples.t: I usually check my phone in the morning.

examples.uz: U hech qachon onlayn o‘yin o‘ynamaydi.

scenes.say_native: Odatlarni tasvirlash uchun hozirgi oddiy zamon va takrorlanish so‘zlari kerak. Ular: “always”, “usually”, “often”, “sometimes”, “never”. Ular asosiy fe’ldan oldin turadi: “I usually check my phone”. Lekin “be” fe’lidan keyin keladi: “I am always online”. Vaqt iboralari esa oxirda turadi: “every day”, “twice a day”, “all the time”. “Never” o‘zida inkorni olib yuradi, shuning uchun “don’t” kerak emas.
scenes.say: I usually check my phone in the morning. I am always online. She never plays games online.
scenes.say_uz: Men odatda ertalab telefonimni tekshiraman. Men doim onlaynman. U hech qachon onlayn o‘yin o‘ynamaydi.

scenes.title: Never va don't
scenes.say_native: Ikki xato. Birinchisi: ikki inkor. O‘zbek tilida “men hech qachon ishlatmayman” deymiz, ya’ni inkor ikki joyda bor. Ingliz tilida esa bitta inkor yetarli: “I never use Facebook”. “Don’t never” noto‘g‘ri. Ikkinchisi: “always” ning o‘rni. U fe’ldan oldin turadi: “I always check my phone”, “I check always” emas. Bu ikki qoidani yodda tuting, har kuni kerak bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: I never use Facebook. I always check my phone.
scenes.say_uz: Men hech qachon Facebookdan foydalanmayman. Men doim telefonimni tekshiraman.

scenes.title: O‘z odatlaringiz
scenes.say_native: Uchta vaqt uchun telefondan nima qilishingizni ayting. Ertalab, avtobusda va uxlashdan oldin. Har bir gapda takrorlanish so‘zini ishlating: always, usually, sometimes yoki never. Masalan, “In the morning, I usually check messages”. Javoblaringiz har kimda har xil bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: What do you do on your phone in the morning, on the bus and before bed? Use always, usually, sometimes or never.
scenes.say_uz: Ertalab, avtobusda va uxlashdan oldin telefonda nima qilasiz? Always, usually, sometimes yoki never ishlating.

scenes.title: Namuna javoblar
board: In the morning, I usually check messages.
On the bus, I often listen to music.
Before bed, I sometimes watch videos.
scenes.say_native: Namunalar: “In the morning, I usually check messages.” “On the bus, I often listen to music.” “Before bed, I sometimes watch videos.” Ko‘rdingizmi, vaqt iborasi gap boshida turishi mumkin, uni vergul bilan ajratamiz. Siz ham shu tuzilmani ishlatgan bo‘lsangiz, juda yaxshi. Uy vazifangiz aynan shunga o‘xshash bo‘ladi, shuning uchun mashq qilishda davom eting.
scenes.say: In the morning, I usually check messages. On the bus, I often listen to music. Before bed, I sometimes watch videos.
scenes.say_uz: Ertalab men odatda xabarlarni tekshiraman. Avtobusda men ko‘pincha musiqa tinglayman. Uxlashdan oldin men ba’zan video ko‘raman.

scenes.title: Ekran vaqti
board: I spend two hours a day on my phone.

examples.t: I spend an hour on social media.
examples.uz: Men ijtimoiy tarmoqlarga bir soat sarflayman.

examples.t: How long do you spend online?

scenes.say_native: Telefonga qancha vaqt sarflashni “spend time” bilan aytamiz. Tuzilma: “spend” va vaqt, keyin “on” va ot yoki “-ing” shaklidagi fe’l. “I spend two hours on my phone” yoki “I spend two hours watching videos”. Savol: “How long do you spend online?” Yoki “How many hours a day...?” Ekranda o‘tkazilgan vaqt — “screen time”. Telefonlar buni avtomatik hisoblab beradi.
scenes.say: I spend two hours a day on my phone. I spend an hour watching videos. How long do you spend online?
scenes.say_uz: Men kuniga ikki soat telefonda o‘tkazaman. Men bir soat video ko‘rib o‘tkazaman. Siz onlaynda qancha vaqt o‘tkazasiz?

scenes.title: Birinchi dialog: telefon odatlari
board: A: How long do you spend on your phone?
B: About four hours a day!
A: Wow. What do you do?
scenes.say_native: Birinchi dialog: ikki do‘st telefon odatlari haqida gaplashadi. Tinglang: kuniga necha soat telefonda o‘tkazadi va nimalar qiladi? Ikkinchi shaxs qanday maslahat beradi? Raqamlarga va takrorlanish so‘zlariga e’tibor bering. Savollar dialogdan keyin.
scenes.say: Sam: How long do you spend on your phone, Lena? Lena: About four hours a day! Sam: Wow. What do you do? Lena: I usually watch videos and chat with friends. I sometimes play games. Sam: I never play games. I mostly read the news. Lena: Maybe I should spend less time online. Sam: Try turning off notifications.
scenes.say_uz: Sem: Lena, telefonda qancha vaqt o‘tkazasan? Lena: Kuniga taxminan to‘rt soat! Sem: Voy. Nima qilasan? Lena: Odatda video ko‘raman va do‘stlar bilan yozishaman. Ba’zan o‘yin o‘ynayman. Sem: Men hech qachon o‘ynamayman. Asosan yangiliklar o‘qiyman. Lena: Balki onlaynda kamroq vaqt o‘tkazishim kerak. Sem: Bildirishnomalarni o‘chirib ko‘r.

scenes.title: Dialog bo‘yicha savollar
board: 1) How long does Lena spend online?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savol. Birinchi: Lena onlaynda qancha vaqt o‘tkazadi? Ikkinchi: u odatda nima qiladi? Uchinchi: Semning maslahati nima? Javobni to‘liq gap bilan ayting. Lena haqida gapirsangiz, fe’lga “-s” qo‘shishni unutmang: she spends, she watches.
scenes.say: How long does Lena spend online? What does she usually do? What is Sam's advice?
scenes.say_uz: Lena onlaynda qancha vaqt o‘tkazadi? U odatda nima qiladi? Semning maslahati nima?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: Lena kuniga taxminan to‘rt soat o‘tkazadi. Ikkinchi: u odatda video ko‘radi va do‘stlari bilan yozishadi, ba’zan o‘yin o‘ynaydi. Uchinchi: Sem bildirishnomalarni o‘chirishni maslahat beradi, “turn off notifications”. Bu yerda “try” dan keyin “-ing” kelgan: “try turning off”, ya’ni “o‘chirib ko‘ring”. Bu ibora sinab ko‘rish ma’nosini bildiradi.
scenes.say: About four hours a day. She watches videos and chats with friends. Sam says: turn off notifications.
scenes.say_uz: Kuniga taxminan to‘rt soat. U video ko‘radi va do‘stlari bilan yozishadi. Sem aytadi: bildirishnomalarni o‘chiring.

scenes.title: Internetning afzalliklari
board: You can learn, work and talk online.

examples.t: It is easy to find information.
One advantage is that we can talk to family abroad.
examples.uz: Bir afzalligi shuki, chet eldagi oila bilan gaplashamiz.

scenes.say_native: Endi afzallik va kamchiliklar. Afzallik — “advantage” yoki “pro”, kamchilik — “disadvantage” yoki “con”. Internetning afzalliklari: “It’s easy to find information”, “we can talk to family abroad”, “you can learn online”. Gapni boshlash uchun: “One advantage is that...” Yana foydali ibora: “It helps me to...” Qoida: “easy” dan keyin “to” va fe’l: easy to find. Bunday shakl A2 darajasida juda foydali.
scenes.say: It's easy to find information. One advantage is that we can talk to family abroad. It helps me learn English.
scenes.say_uz: Ma’lumot topish oson. Bir afzalligi shuki, chet eldagi oila bilan gaplasha olamiz. U ingliz tilini o‘rganishimga yordam beradi.

scenes.title: Kamchiliklar
board: too much screen time · fake news

examples.t: One disadvantage is that it takes a lot of time.
examples.uz: Bir kamchiligi shuki, u ko‘p vaqt oladi.

examples.t: Too much screen time is bad for your eyes.
examples.uz: Ko‘p ekran vaqti ko‘zingiz uchun zararli.

scenes.say_native: Kamchiliklar. “One disadvantage is that it takes a lot of time.” Boshqa kamchiliklar: “fake news” — soxta yangiliklar, “addictive” — odatga aylanib qoluvchi, “dangerous” — xavfli. “Too much screen time is bad for your eyes” — ko‘p ekran vaqti ko‘zlar uchun zararli. Eslang: “bad for” — biror narsa uchun zararli, “good for” — foydali. Ikkala tomonni aytish fikringizni muvozanatli ko‘rsatadi.
scenes.say: One disadvantage is that it takes a lot of time. Fake news can be dangerous. Too much screen time is bad for your eyes.
scenes.say_uz: Bir kamchiligi shuki, u ko‘p vaqt oladi. Soxta yangiliklar xavfli bo‘lishi mumkin. Ko‘p ekran vaqti ko‘zlaringiz uchun zararli.

scenes.title: Qarama-qarshi fikrni bog‘lash
board: On the one hand... on the other hand...

examples.t: It is useful, but it takes time.
On the one hand it is fast. On the other hand it is tiring.
examples.uz: Bir tomondan tez. Ikkinchi tomondan charchatadi.

scenes.say_native: Afzallik va kamchilikni bog‘lash uchun “but” — lekin. Yozma yoki jiddiyroq gapda “however” — biroq, undan keyin vergul. “On the one hand... on the other hand...” — bir tomondan..., ikkinchi tomondan.... Misol: “Social media is fun. However, it takes a lot of time.” “But” gap o‘rtasida, “however” esa odatda yangi gap boshida turadi. Shu uchtasi bilan fikringiz ancha chiroyli chiqadi.
scenes.say: Social media is fun, but it takes a lot of time. However, it is useful for news. On the one hand it is fast. On the other hand it is tiring.
scenes.say_uz: Ijtimoiy tarmoq qiziqarli, lekin ko‘p vaqt oladi. Biroq yangiliklar uchun foydali. Bir tomondan tez. Ikkinchi tomondan charchatadi.

scenes.title: Pro va con gaplaridagi xato
scenes.say_native: Sifat va ot ko‘p chalkashadi. Birinchi xato: “be” fe’lidan keyin ravish emas, sifat keladi: “useful”, “usefully” emas. Ikkinchi xato: “danger” — bu ot, xavf. Sifat esa “dangerous”, xavfli. Shunga o‘xshash juftliklar: “help — helpful”, “use — useful”, “addiction — addictive”. Qoida: “is”, “are” dan keyin sifat qo‘yamiz. Shuning uchun “It is dangerous” deymiz, “It is danger” emas.
scenes.say: The internet is very useful. It is dangerous. Phones are helpful.
scenes.say_uz: Internet juda foydali. U xavfli. Telefonlar foydali.

scenes.title: Afzallik va kamchilik
scenes.say_native: Mavzu — ijtimoiy tarmoq. Bitta afzallik va bitta kamchilik ayting va ularni “but” yoki “however” bilan bog‘lang. Masalan, “One advantage is that I can see friends’ photos, but it takes a lot of time.” O‘zingizning variantingizni o‘ylab toping. Gaplarni to‘liq ayting.
scenes.say: Topic: social media. Say one advantage and one disadvantage. Connect them with but or however.
scenes.say_uz: Mavzu: ijtimoiy tarmoq. Bitta afzallik va bitta kamchilik ayting. Ularni but yoki however bilan bog‘lang.

scenes.title: Namuna javob
board: One advantage is that I can talk to friends.
However, it takes a lot of time.
I think we should use it less.
scenes.say_native: Namuna: “One advantage is that I can talk to my friends. However, it takes a lot of time.” Mana yana bir fikr: “I think we should use it less.” Siz boshqa fikrlarni ham aytgan bo‘lishingiz mumkin, masalan, yangiliklar yoki ma’lumot haqida. Muhimi — ikki tomonni ko‘rsatish. Shu yo‘l bilan siz ishonarli va o‘ylangan javob berasiz.
scenes.say: One advantage is that I can talk to my friends. However, it takes a lot of time. I think we should use it less.
scenes.say_uz: Bir afzalligi shuki, do‘stlarim bilan gaplasha olaman. Biroq u ko‘p vaqt oladi. Menimcha, undan kamroq foydalanishimiz kerak.

scenes.title: Xabar yozish: qisqartmalar
board: LOL — kulgili · BTW — by the way
scenes.say_native: Xabar yozishda qisqartmalar juda ko‘p. “LOL” — kulgi, “BTW” — “by the way”, ya’ni aytgancha, “ASAP” — imkon qadar tez, “OMG” — voy xudoyim. “Thx” — thanks, “pls” — please, “u” — you. Ular do‘stlar bilan yozishmada yaxshi. Lekin ish xatida, o‘qituvchiga yoki rasmiy xabarda ishlatmang, u yerda to‘liq so‘zlar kerak. Bilib qo‘ying, o‘qish uchun ularni tushunish yetarli.
scenes.say: LOL. BTW, I'm late. See you tomorrow! Thanks! Please call me ASAP.
scenes.say_uz: Ha-ha. Aytgancha, men kechikaman. Ertagacha! Rahmat! Iltimos, menga imkon qadar tez qo‘ng‘iroq qiling.

scenes.title: Telefonda gaplashish
board: Hello, this is Anna. / Who's calling?
Can I speak to Tom, please?
Hold on. / I'll call you back.

examples.t: Can I speak to Tom, please?

scenes.say_native: Telefonda gaplashganda “I am Anna” demaymiz, “This is Anna” deymiz. Kim bilan gaplashmoqchi ekanimizni “Can I speak to Tom, please?” bilan so‘raymiz. Javob: “Hold on” yoki “Just a moment” — bir daqiqa kuting. “Who’s calling?” — kim qo‘ng‘iroq qilyapti? Gaplashib bo‘lgach “I’ll call you back” — sizga qayta qo‘ng‘iroq qilaman. Bu o‘zbekcha “men falonchiman” deyishdan farq qiladi.
scenes.say: Hello, this is Anna. Can I speak to Tom, please? Hold on. I'll call you back.
scenes.say_uz: Assalomu alaykum, bu Anna. Tom bilan gaplashsam bo‘ladimi? Biroz kuting. Sizga qayta qo‘ng‘iroq qilaman.

scenes.title: Aloqa muammolari
board: I can't hear you. · The line is bad.
My battery is dead. · No signal.
scenes.say_native: Aloqa buzilganda nima deymiz? “Sorry, I can’t hear you” — kechirasiz, eshitolmayapman. “The line is bad” — aloqa yomon. “Can you repeat that, please?” — takrorlay olasizmi? Telefon haqida: “My battery is dead” — batareyam tugadi, ingliz tilida “o‘lgan” deymiz. “No signal” — tarmoq yo‘q. Bu iboralar sizni qiyin vaziyatda qutqaradi, shuning uchun ularni yaxshilab eslab qoling.
scenes.say: Sorry, I can't hear you. The line is bad. Can you repeat that, please? My battery is almost dead.
scenes.say_uz: Kechirasiz, sizni eshitolmayapman. Aloqa yomon. Takrorlay olasizmi? Batareyam deyarli tugadi.

scenes.title: Ikkinchi dialog: telefon qo‘ng‘irog‘i
board: B: Hi Mia, it's Dan. Can you hear me?
A: Sorry, the line is bad.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog: telefon qo‘ng‘irog‘i. Dan Miyaga qo‘ng‘iroq qiladi, lekin aloqa yomon. Tinglang: Dan nima uchun qo‘ng‘iroq qilyapti, nima uchun Miya uni eshitmayapti va ular qachon uchrashishga kelishadi? Telefon iboralariga e’tibor bering.
scenes.say: Mia: Hello, this is Mia. Dan: Hi Mia, it's Dan. Can you hear me? Mia: Sorry, the line is bad. Can you repeat that? Dan: I'm calling about Saturday. Are you free? Mia: Yes, I am. Dan: Great. Let's meet at two. Mia: Perfect. Send me a message with the address. Dan: OK, I'll text you now. See you!
scenes.say_uz: Miya: Assalomu alaykum, Miya eshitadi. Dan: Salom Miya, bu Dan. Meni eshityapsanmi? Miya: Kechir, aloqa yomon. Takrorlay olasanmi? Dan: Shanba haqida qo‘ng‘iroq qilyapman. Bo‘shmisan? Miya: Ha, bo‘shman. Dan: Ajoyib. Soat ikkida uchrashaylik. Miya: Zo‘r. Manzilni xabar qilib yubor. Dan: Mayli, hozir yozaman. Ko‘rishguncha!

scenes.title: Savollar
board: 2) What is the problem with the call?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savol. Birinchi: Dan nima uchun qo‘ng‘iroq qiladi? Ikkinchi: qo‘ng‘iroqda qanday muammo bor? Uchinchi: ular soat nechada uchrashadi? Dialogni esga oling va javoblarni to‘liq gap bilan ayting. Dan haqida gapirganda “he” va fe’lga “-s” ishlating.
scenes.say: Why does Dan call? What is the problem with the call? What time do they meet?
scenes.say_uz: Dan nima uchun qo‘ng‘iroq qiladi? Qo‘ng‘iroqda qanday muammo bor? Ular soat nechada uchrashadi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: Dan shanba kuni haqida qo‘ng‘iroq qiladi, “about Saturday”. Ikkinchi: aloqa yomon, “the line is bad”. Uchinchi: ular soat ikkida uchrashadi, “at two”. Manzilni esa Dan xabar qilib yuboradi, “text” fe’li shuni bildiradi: “I’ll text you” — men sizga SMS yozaman. “Text” bu yerda fe’l bo‘lib kelgan. Bu ingliz tilida juda keng tarqalgan.
scenes.say: He calls about Saturday. The line is bad. They meet at two. He will text the address.
scenes.say_uz: U shanba haqida qo‘ng‘iroq qiladi. Aloqa yomon. Ular soat ikkida uchrashadi. U manzilni yozib yuboradi.

scenes.title: Xavfsizlik va odob
board: Be polite online. Think before you post.
scenes.say_native: Raqamli muloqotda xavfsizlik va odob muhim. “Don’t share your password” — parolingizni bermang. “Don’t click strange links” — g‘alati havolalarni bosmang. Buyruq gaplarda “don’t” va fe’l ishlatiladi, “you” kerak emas. Odob qoidasi: “Be polite online” — onlaynda ham muloyim bo‘ling, “Think before you post” — joylashdan oldin o‘ylang. Internetga qo‘yilgan narsa uzoq saqlanadi.
scenes.say: Don't share your password. Don't click strange links. Be polite online. Think before you post.
scenes.say_uz: Parolingizni bermang. G‘alati havolalarni bosmang. Onlaynda muloyim bo‘ling. Joylashdan oldin o‘ylang.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: bog‘lanish
scenes.say_native: Tabiiy nutqda so‘zlar bir-biriga bog‘lanadi. Undosh bilan tugagan so‘z unli bilan boshlangan so‘zga ulanadi. “Turn it off” alohida uch so‘z emas, balki “tur-ni-toff” kabi eshitiladi. “Check it out” — “che-ki-tout”. “Pick it up” — “pi-ki-tup”. “It” so‘zi qisqa va sust aytiladi. Bu frazal fe’llar bilan olmosh birikmalarida juda ko‘p uchraydi, shuning uchun bu ko‘nikma tinglashni ham yaxshilaydi.
scenes.say: Check it out. Turn it off. Pick it up. Switch it on.
scenes.say_uz: Ko‘rib qo‘ying. Uni o‘chiring. Uni oling. Uni yoqing.

scenes.title: Bog‘lab ayting
scenes.say_native: Takrorlang. Har bir iborani to‘xtovsiz, bir nafasda ayting: “turn it off”, so‘zlar orasida pauza qilmang. Avval sekin, keyin tezroq. O‘zingizni eshiting. “It” ni kuchli aytmang, u qisqa. Agar qiyin bo‘lsa, birinchi undosh va unlini ulab ayting.
scenes.say: Check it out. Turn it off. Pick it up. Switch it on.
scenes.say_uz: Ko‘rib qo‘ying. Uni o‘chiring. Uni oling. Uni yoqing.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasiga tayyorgarlik
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifangiz telefondan har kuni qanday foydalanishingizni tasvirlash. Reja: birinchi, qaysi ilovalarni ishlatasiz. Ikkinchi, qachon va qancha vaqt. Uchinchi, nima uchun. To‘rtinchi, bitta afzallik va bitta kamchilik. Ishlating: “I usually...”, “I spend... hours”, “One advantage is that...”. Namuna: “I usually check Telegram in the morning. I spend two hours a day on my phone.”
scenes.say: Which apps do you use? When, and for how long? What for? Say one pro and one con.
scenes.say_uz: Qaysi ilovalarni ishlatasiz? Qachon va qancha vaqt? Nima uchun? Bitta afzallik va bitta kamchilik ayting.

scenes.title: Telefon kuningiz
scenes.say_native: Endi navbat sizda. Telefondan bir kunda qanday foydalanishingizni ayting. Kamida sakkizta gap. Ilovalar, vaqt, nima uchun va bitta afzallik hamda kamchilik. Takrorlanish so‘zlarini va “spend time” ni ishlating. Sekin va aniq gapiring, to‘liq gaplar bilan.
scenes.say: Describe how you use your phone every day. Say which apps, when, how long, why, and one pro and one con.
scenes.say_uz: Telefondan har kuni qanday foydalanishingizni tasvirlang. Ilovalar, vaqt, sabab, bitta afzallik va kamchilik.

scenes.title: Namuna javob
board: I usually check Telegram in the morning.
I spend about two hours a day on my phone.
One disadvantage is that it takes time.
scenes.say_native: Namuna javob: “I usually check Telegram in the morning. During the day, I often use a dictionary app. I spend about two hours a day on my phone. In the evening, I sometimes watch videos. One advantage is that I can learn English with apps. However, one disadvantage is that it takes time.” Mana shunday. Gaplar oddiy, lekin tartibli. Siz ham shuncha gap ayta olasiz.
scenes.say: I usually check Telegram in the morning. I spend about two hours a day on my phone. One advantage is that I can learn English. However, it takes time.
scenes.say_uz: Men odatda ertalab Telegramni tekshiraman. Kuniga taxminan ikki soat telefonda o‘tkazaman. Bir afzalligi shuki, ingliz tilini o‘rgana olaman. Biroq u vaqt oladi.

scenes.title: Britaniya va Amerika

examples.t: I'll ring you on my mobile.

scenes.say_native: Kichik farq. Britaniyada mobil telefon “mobile”, Amerikada “cell phone” yoki “cell”. Qo‘ng‘iroq qilish: Britaniyada “ring” va “give someone a ring” ham ishlatiladi, Amerikada ko‘proq “call”. “Text” ikkala variantda xabar yuborish. Siz “call” ni ishlatsangiz, ikkala joyda tushunishadi, chunki bu eng umumiy variant. Ayniqsa, Britaniya inglizchasini o‘rgansangiz, “mobile” ni yodlab oling.
scenes.say: In Britain, a phone is a mobile. In America, it is a cell phone. We say call or ring.
scenes.say_uz: Britaniyada telefon mobile deyiladi. Amerikada cell phone. Biz call yoki ring deymiz.

scenes.title: Dars xulosasi
board: Tech words: smartphone, app, Wi-Fi, account
Pros and cons: but / however · phone phrases
scenes.say_native: Xulosa. Bugun texnika so‘zlarini o‘rgandik. Onlayn odatlarni takrorlanish so‘zlari va “spend time” bilan tasvirladik. Afzallik va kamchiliklarni “one advantage is” hamda “however” bilan aytdik. Telefonda gaplashish va xabar yozish iboralarini o‘rgandik. Xatolardan qochdik: Telegram oldida artikl yo‘q, “turn it off”, “I never use”. Siz katta ish qildingiz!
scenes.say: Today you learned tech words, online habits, pros and cons and phone phrases. Great work!
scenes.say_uz: Bugun siz texnika so‘zlarini, onlayn odatlarni, afzallik va kamchiliklarni va telefon iboralarini o‘rgandingiz. Ajoyib ish!

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi
board: Describe how you use your phone each day
Apps · time · why · pro and con
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: telefondan har kuni qanday foydalanishingizni tasvirlang. Bir daqiqa gapiring va o‘zingizni yozib oling. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: kamida sakkizta gap, kamida uchta takrorlanish so‘zi, bitta afzallik va bitta kamchilik. Keyingi darsda hayotiy tajriba haqida gapirishni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Homework: describe how you use your phone each day. See you in the next lesson!
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifasi: telefondan har kuni qanday foydalanishingizni tasvirlang. Keyingi darsda ko‘rishamiz!

homework_uz: Telefondan har kuni qanday foydalanishingizni bir daqiqa davomida tasvirlang va o‘zingizni yozib oling. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: kamida sakkizta gap; qaysi ilovalar, qachon va qancha vaqt (spend time), kamida uchta takrorlanish so‘zi (always, usually, never...) va bitta afzallik hamda bitta kamchilik.
